escalation: If you need contract advice, have a guarantor problem, or want to hold a specific room today: leave your name, email and university and our lettings team will call you back within one working day. For maintenance emergencies in halls, call the on-site team on the number in your welcome pack.

faqs.q: What room types do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer shared twin rooms from £119 a week, en-suite rooms from £149 a week, and studios from £229 a week. All rooms come furnished with a study desk, ample storage and a comfy double bed.

faqs.q: Are bills included in the rent?
faqs.a: Yes — gas, electricity, water, 100Mb Wi-Fi and contents insurance are all included in the weekly rent. There is fair-use capping on energy, but most students never hit it.

faqs.q: Do I need a guarantor, and what are my options as an international student booking a room?
faqs.a: Yes — every tenancy needs a UK-based guarantor earning at least 36 times the monthly rent. Your options as an international student without a UK guarantor: use our approved guarantor service from around £295 per tenancy, or pay a larger rent deposit instead.

faqs.q: When should I book, and is there availability?
faqs.a: Rooms for September usually sell out by June, so booking before Easter gives you the best choice. Share your name, email and university and we will check live availability for your city and dates.

faqs.q: Can I book a viewing before I commit?
faqs.a: Absolutely — we run in-person and video viewings Monday to Saturday. Send your name, email and university and we will confirm a viewing slot within one working day.

faqs.q: How long are contracts, and can I cancel?
faqs.a: Standard contracts run 44 or 51 weeks to match the academic year. You can cancel within a 72-hour cooling-off period after signing; after that you may re-let your room to another student with our free re-let matching service.
